title: Network policies: denied flows
description: Flows that the network policies deny (action dropped) or would deny in audit mode (action audit), per workload, from the Hubble metrics `policy` and `drop`. See docs/cluster/README.md#network-policies.

list.name: action
list.label: Verdict
list.description: audit: denied once the policies are enforced (audit mode). dropped: denied now.

panels.title: Policy verdicts per flow
panels.description: Rate of the denied (or audited) flows, per source and destination workload. The workload is the one of the pod, else its app label, else the reserved identity (reserved:world, reserved:host...). The empty namespaces are those outside the cluster.

targets.expr: sum by (action, direction, source_namespace, source, destination_namespace, destination) (rate(hubble_policy_verdicts_total{action=~"$action", source_namespace=~"$source_namespace", destination_namespace=~"$destination_namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Denied flows over the period
panels.description: Count of the denied (or audited) flows over the time range, the flows to allow first at the top.

targets.expr: sum by (action, direction, match, source_namespace, source, destination_namespace, destination) (increase(hubble_policy_verdicts_total{action=~"$action", source_namespace=~"$source_namespace", destination_namespace=~"$destination_namespace"}[$__range])) > 0

panels.title: Dropped packets by reason
panels.description: Every drop of the datapath, not only the policies (POLICY_DENIED). Stays empty for the policies while they are in audit mode.

targets.expr: sum by (reason, source_namespace, source, destination_namespace, destination) (rate(hubble_drop_total{source_namespace=~"$source_namespace", destination_namespace=~"$destination_namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0
